description: Existing upright elongated-object mesh-section grasp program. Select directly with parameters.object_id and arm after get_manip_geometry. Optional parameters.control_steps={pregrasp: estimated steps, contact_close: estimated steps}. Uses the original bottle_grasps sampler and native measured contact offset/aperture; returns ranked pregrasp/contact candidates. Hand must already be open. Reuse as-is, adapt it or write another program when task/shape differs.
author: harness_reference
interface: generate(task, oracle, parameters) -> EEF phases or candidates
validation: Collected for reuse; physical validation is recorded separately
